title: Book V
coreMove: Rise from comfort into the human work that belongs to your nature.
sourcePressure: Morning reluctance is answered by human function, social labor, quick resets, action without scorekeeping, bitter prescriptions from common nature, and repeated return.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: get up earlier and work harder for status

sourceAnchors.name: warm bedclothes
sourceAnchors.detail: Book V opens by attacking morning reluctance: a human being rises for human work, not for warm bedclothes.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Warm bedclothes are persuasive because they ask for nothing except one more surrender.

sourceAnchors.name: plants, birds, ants, spiders, and bees doing their part
sourceAnchors.detail: Book V compares human duty to creatures and plants doing their part in the order of the world.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The bees and ants are not productivity mascots; they shame reason when reason only defends delay.

counterintuition: what looks like control is actually surrender
the real problem is not outside you
tryThisNow: write down what you can control
examples: generic office meeting with laptop and coffee
parent-child bedtime conflict repeated across chapters

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person direct address, retrospective recognition, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

exampleSpecs.audience: David deciding whether to start the depot early
exampleSpecs.stakes: a school route depends on his crew moving before sunrise
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: At 4:36 a.m., David sits up, calls the first driver, and treats the route map as the reason to leave the warm room.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: At 4:36 a.m., David hears sleet ticking against the bedroom window.

exampleSpecs.audience: Sofia arriving after a sleepless night
exampleSpecs.stakes: fatigue is real but the babies still need the first check
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Sofia accepts the coffee, then checks the incubator alarms before discussing how tired she is.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Blue monitor light trembles on the plastic incubator walls.

exampleSpecs.audience: Chiara tempted to call in sick after a hard week
exampleSpecs.stakes: one missed interpreter can delay a protective order
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: You watch Chiara put on the headset and start with the frightened witness rather than her own resentment.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: You feel the foam headset warm against one ear.

exampleSpecs.audience: Luke responsible for the first bake after a staff shortage
exampleSpecs.stakes: the neighborhood orders fail if he negotiates with comfort
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Luke turns on the deck oven before checking messages, so the work begins before excuses assemble.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: The proofing racks stand in the dark like a quiet accusation.

exampleSpecs.audience: Manon opening when roads are bad
exampleSpecs.stakes: patients need prescriptions more than she needs a perfect mood
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: "Open at nine," Manon tells the delivery driver, then shovels the door clear herself.

exampleSpecs.audience: Peter resetting chairs after a cancellation
exampleSpecs.stakes: the unglamorous setup is the social work that lets music happen
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: It took Peter one cancelled rehearsal to see that chair rows were not beneath the music.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: It took Peter one cancelled rehearsal to stop calling setup invisible work.

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a question to the reader, a research aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'

skillTargets: separate bounded rest from comfort as rival end

tryThisNowSpec: When comfort argues for delay, answer with the first duty your role was made to perform, then stand up and do it.
